name: refactor-with-tests
description: A TypeScript formatting module is split in two: lib/format.ts is renamed to lib/format/number.ts and the date helpers move to a new lib/format/date.ts with its own test file; one consumer updates its imports. The brief should describe the split/rename, keep risk low-to-medium, and tag the new test file as a test.

pr.title: Split lib/format into number and date modules
pr.body:
The PDF export worker imports `formatMoney` but pulls in the date helpers too, which throw at import time because the worker bundle has no Intl locale data.

- `src/lib/format.ts` -> `src/lib/format/number.ts` (money + percent only)
- date helpers move to `src/lib/format/date.ts`
- `InvoiceRow` updates its imports
- new `date.test.ts`; while moving `formatRelative` I also made it say `in N days` for future dates instead of `-3 days ago`.
pr.author: dvoss
